description.value:
You hurl a crackling bolt of lightning at a target you choose within range, from which up to three additional bolts arc outward to strike as many other targets within 30 feet of the first; each target, whether creature or object, can be struck by only one bolt.

Each target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 10d8 lightning damage, taking half as much on a success.

Casting this power with a force slot of 7th level or higher adds one additional branching bolt for each slot level beyond 6th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 6
